fault_description: TCP Top Power deviated +50W above set-point on wafer 2915 (410W measured vs 360W max). Acute step-change detected at timestep 47, not gradual drift. RF generator hours at fault: 1241.04. Lot LOT_29B held pending investigation.
root_cause: TCP generator impedance matching network failure after >1240 hrs continuous operation. Capacitor bank bench-tested at 68% nominal capacitance. Step-change characteristic confirms partial capacitor bank failure rather than progressive drift.
work_description: Isolated TCP generator. Replaced capacitor bank assembly P/N IMP-CAP-7730. Replaced O-ring kit TCP-SEAL-O42. Recalibrated TCP power set-point at 350W. Ran 3 qualification wafers before returning chamber to production.
resolution: CLOSED — TCP power stable within +/-1.5W post-repair. Three qualification wafers passed CD and uniformity specs. Recommended TCP power monitoring every 5 wafers for 2 weeks.

fault_description: RF Bottom Power deviated +10W above set-point on wafer 2917 (152W measured vs 142W max). Deviation mid-etch at step 3, returned to normal by step 5 without intervention. RF Phase Error elevated at 890 counts (normal <600).
root_cause: Transient RF impedance mismatch from plasma ignition instability at low-pressure regime (945 mTorr). RF matching network tuner overcorrected on re-ignition, causing brief +10W overshoot. No component failure — classified as plasma re-ignition transient.
work_description: Inspected RF generator and matching network — no component failure found. Verified RF cable connections and interlock wiring. Adjusted RF tuner response algorithm to reduce overshoot on plasma re-ignition events. Ran 2 qualification wafers at boundary pressure conditions.
resolution: CLOSED — RF power stable within +/-2W after tuner parameter adjustment. Qualification wafers passed at low-pressure conditions. Recommended monitoring RF Phase Error on subsequent LOT_29B wafers.

fault_description: TCP Top Power deviated +10W above set-point on wafer 2936 (370W measured vs 360W max). Minor deviation 14 wafers after WO-CHA-2915 capacitor bank replacement. Gradual drift suggesting incomplete resolution of WO-CHA-2915 root cause.
root_cause: Residual impedance drift following capacitor bank replacement on WO-CHA-2915. Replacement capacitor bank required additional burn-in stabilization. TCP power set-point recalibration carried a minor +8W offset that accumulated over subsequent wafers.
work_description: Re-inspected TCP generator impedance matching network. Found TCP power set-point drifted +8W from post-repair baseline. Recalibrated TCP power reference. Verified connector torque on all impedance network joints. Ran 1 qualification wafer.
resolution: CLOSED — TCP power recalibrated to 350W set-point. Post-repair drift resolved. No further deviations on remaining LOT_29B wafers. Recommended reducing wet clean PM interval given cumulative process drift.

fault_description: He Backside Cooling Pressure dropped to 85 Torr on wafer 2940 (threshold 90 Torr). Wafer lift-off from chuck detected during etch, causing incomplete etch and wafer loss. Chamber shut down immediately on endpoint anomaly.
root_cause: ESC He feed-through O-ring seal degraded after 2147 cumulative thermal cycles (rated for 2000 cycles). Progressive seal compression set created He leak path at inner seal interface. Seal P/N ESC-SEAL-HE9 confirmed failed on bench inspection.
work_description: Vented chamber to atmosphere. Removed ESC He feed-through assembly. Replaced He feed-through O-ring seal P/N ESC-SEAL-HE9. He circuit leak-checked to 1e-9 Torr-L/s with mass spectrometer. Reinstalled ESC, performed 50 thermal cycles, ran 2 He pressure qualification wafers.
resolution: CLOSED — He backside pressure stable at 95 Torr (nominal). Leak test passed. 50-cycle qualification completed without pressure deviation. Reset thermal cycle counter. Recommend seal inspection at 1800 cycles going forward.

fault_description: TCP Top Power deviated +30W on wafer 3120 (380W measured vs 360W max). Third TCP deviation on CHA in 21 days following WO-CHA-2915 and WO-CHA-2936. RF generator hours: 1241.73. RF power supply board ripple measured at 2.1% vs 1.0% maximum specification.
root_cause: TCP generator RF power supply board (PSB) aging — output ripple increased from 0.8% to 2.1% at 350W set-point. PSB degradation causing TCP power instability under plasma load transitions. Distinct from WO-CHA-2915 capacitor bank failure: this is PSB-level aging unresolved by prior repair.
work_description: Ran extended TCP generator diagnostic. Confirmed PSB ripple out of spec. Replaced TCP generator power supply board P/N TCP-PSB-3300. Recalibrated full TCP power chain. Ran 5 qualification wafers across recipe power range 300-380W.
resolution: CLOSED — TCP power stable within +/-1W across full recipe range. PSB ripple at 0.6% post-repair. Recommend full TCP generator inspection at next scheduled Full PM given recurrence pattern.

fault_description: RF Bottom Power deviated +8W on wafer 3122 (150W measured vs 142W max). Second RF deviation on CHA in 21 days following WO-CHA-2917. RF Phase Error std dev 890 counts vs normal <600 counts, indicating RF matching instability.
root_cause: RF matching network capacitor C2 drifted to 92% nominal capacitance (below 95% spec). Tuner compensation masking fault under normal conditions but unable to compensate at off-nominal plasma impedance edge conditions. Progressive component drift distinct from WO-CHA-2917 ignition transient.
work_description: Removed RF matching network. Bench-tested all capacitors — found C2 at 92% nominal. Replaced RF matching network capacitor board P/N RF-MATCH-CAP-BD. Reinstalled and retuned matching network. Ran 3 qualification wafers including edge-condition recipe.
resolution: CLOSED — RF power stable within +/-1.5W including edge pressure conditions. RF Phase Error std dev reduced to 420 counts. Recommended reducing RF matching capacitor board replacement interval from 18 to 12 months.

fault_description: TCP Top Power deviated +20W on wafer 3341 (370W vs 360W max). Fourth TCP deviation on CHA since 2024-03-04. Wet clean PM overdue by 8 wafers (count 43, interval 35). TCP power meter calibration overdue by 10 days at fault date.
root_cause: Compound root cause: (1) TCP power meter calibration drift (+18W offset at 350W set-point confirmed on recalibration) allowed control loop to accept offset as in-spec; (2) chamber wall polymer deposition from overdue wet clean raised plasma impedance, requiring higher TCP power to maintain etch rate.
work_description: Performed emergency wet clean (8 wafers overdue). Recalibrated TCP power meter — confirmed +18W offset at 350W set-point. Ran full TCP power calibration sequence. Verified chamber cleanliness with particle count <5 per wafer. Ran 3 qualification wafers.
resolution: CLOSED — TCP power stable within +/-1.5W after calibration and wet clean. Particle count passed. Recommend TCP power meter calibration interval reduced to 60 days and strict 35-wafer wet clean interval enforcement.

fault_description: TCP Top Power drifted +18W over 22 wafers on LOT_28A (368W measured vs 360W max). Gradual drift detected by SPC trend alert. RF generator hours: 1238.5 at fault. Minor process shift observed in endpoint peak values.
root_cause: Incremental TCP power set-point drift from early-stage capacitor bank degradation beginning at ~1235 RF generator hours. Drift rate of ~0.8W per wafer consistent with capacitor aging prior to acute failure mode seen on WO-CHA-2915.
work_description: Recalibrated TCP power set-point — found 16W offset at 350W. Inspected impedance matching network; capacitor bank still within spec at 81% nominal capacitance. Applied calibration correction. Flagged capacitor bank for replacement at next PM cycle.
resolution: CLOSED — TCP power drift corrected by calibration. Capacitor bank flagged for WO-CHA-2915 replacement. LOT_28A wafers released after quality review confirmed no metrology impact.

fault_description: TCP Top Power stepped down -25W on wafer 2750 during step 4 (325W measured vs 334W min). Acute loss of TCP power mid-etch at 1221 RF generator hours. Etch stopped 60% complete. Wet clean was 12 wafers overdue at time of fault.
root_cause: TCP coil surface contamination (polymer accumulation from overdue wet clean) caused localized arcing event at high-power set-point. Arcing damaged coil surface coating at one segment. Overdue wet clean (12 wafers past interval) directly contributed to polymer bridging enabling arc path.
work_description: Inspected TCP coil assembly — identified arc damage on coil segment 3. Cleaned all coil surfaces with IPA and coil cleaning compound. Replaced TCP coil insulator P/N TCP-COIL-INS-7. Performed chamber wet clean. Recalibrated TCP power after coil reinstallation.
resolution: CLOSED — TCP power stable post-repair. Strict enforcement of 35-wafer wet clean interval implemented following this event. Wet clean overdue was direct contributing factor.

fault_description: RF Bottom Power oscillated +/-15W around set-point for 12 consecutive wafers on LOT_27A. RF Phase Error std dev exceeded 1200 counts. Oscillation pattern consistent with RF matching network instability rather than RF generator output failure.
root_cause: RF matching network capacitor board showing multiple capacitors at 88-93% nominal capacitance — board at end of service life. Collective degradation caused resonance frequency shift and hunting behavior in the auto-match algorithm.
work_description: Replaced RF matching network capacitor board P/N RF-MATCH-CAP-BD. Retuned matching network to new capacitor nominal values. Ran 5 qualification wafers with RF Phase Error monitoring. Confirmed oscillation eliminated.
resolution: CLOSED — RF power stable within +/-1W after capacitor board replacement. RF Phase Error std dev normalized to 380 counts. Established 12-month replacement interval for RF matching capacitor board on CHA.

fault_description: RF Generator failed to ignite plasma on wafer 2680 — zero RF output at 132W set-point. Generator fault code 0x47 logged (output overcurrent protection trip). Chamber downtime 18 hours. Unit had 975 RF operating hours at failure.
root_cause: RF generator internal power amplifier transistor Q3 failed short-circuit, triggering overcurrent protection. Unit at 975 RF hours — within expected service life but at high end of operating envelope for this generator model under CHA plasma conditions.
work_description: Removed RF generator module from service. Bench diagnosis confirmed PA transistor Q3 short failure. Replaced RF generator module P/N RF-GEN-4500 with spare from parts room. Replaced RF cable assembly RF-CABLE-28A as precaution. Recalibrated RF power output. Ran 5 qualification wafers.
resolution: CLOSED — New RF generator module performing within spec. RF power stable within +/-1W. Failed RF-GEN-4500 sent to vendor for repair/recertification. NOTE: Only spare RF-GEN-4500 consumed — now OUT OF STOCK, lead time 21 days.

fault_description: BCl3 flow deviated +12 sccm above set-point on wafer 2650 (762 sccm measured vs 765 sccm max threshold). SPC run rule violation: 7 consecutive points trending toward upper limit. Process drift of 0.4 sccm/wafer over 18 wafers prior to fault.
root_cause: BCl3 MFC transducer calibration drift after 14 months of continuous BCl3 service exposure. BCl3 is corrosive to MFC transducer internals — drift rate consistent with transducer diaphragm corrosion. Calibration was 67 days prior, exceeding 60-day interval for corrosive gas service.
work_description: Replaced BCl3 MFC transducer P/N MFC-BCL3-T750. Calibrated replacement transducer on certified N2 flow standard. Ran 3 calibration verification runs at 500, 750, and 780 sccm set-points. Confirmed accuracy within +/-1 sccm across full range.
resolution: CLOSED — BCl3 flow stable within +/-0.5 sccm after transducer replacement. Established 60-day calibration interval for BCl3 MFC in corrosive gas service. Reordered replacement transducer to replenish inventory.

fault_description: Cl2 flow deviated -8 sccm below set-point on wafer 2600 (743 sccm measured vs 748 sccm min). Acute low-flow event at step 2 onset. Endpoint signal showed reduced etch rate consistent with Cl2 deficiency. Lot held for CD metrology.
root_cause: Cl2 MFC transducer body seal degradation causing partial Cl2 bypass around sensing element. Seal had not been replaced since chamber installation 16 months prior. Acute flow loss triggered by seal failure propagation under Cl2 corrosion exposure.
work_description: Replaced Cl2 MFC transducer P/N MFC-CL2-T750. Replaced MFC body assembly seal using MFC-BODY-750 kit. Pressure-tested gas line after repair. Calibrated replacement transducer. Ran 3 verification runs at 700, 750, and 760 sccm.
resolution: CLOSED — Cl2 flow stable within +/-0.5 sccm after repair. Established 18-month MFC body seal replacement interval for Cl2 corrosive gas service.

fault_description: He Backside Pressure declined gradually from 95 Torr to 88 Torr over 8 wafers on LOT_25A (threshold 90 Torr). Gradual leak pattern with ~1 Torr loss per wafer. Thermal non-uniformity appeared in endpoint OES spatial data consistent with localized He loss.
root_cause: ESC He distribution channel O-ring seal showing compression set fatigue after 1800 thermal cycles. Gradual leak rate consistent with slow seal pathway developing at O-ring channel interface rather than full feed-through seal failure.
work_description: Performed full ESC He circuit inspection. Identified degraded O-ring seal at He distribution channel port P/N ESC-SEAL-HE9. Replaced all He circuit O-rings as preventive measure. He mass spectrometer leak check on complete He circuit. Thermal cycled 30 times post-repair.
resolution: CLOSED — He backside pressure stable at 95 Torr. Leak test <1e-10 Torr-L/s. Established 1800-cycle inspection interval for He circuit O-rings.

fault_description: Chamber pressure spiked to 1485 mTorr (max 1420 mTorr) on wafer 2500 at step transition. APC butterfly valve position log showed hunting — unable to hold 1200 mTorr set-point. Pressure sensor cross-checked against calibrated reference and confirmed accurate.
root_cause: APC butterfly valve actuator O-ring seal worn from 18 months of repeated thermal and pressure cycling, causing stick-slip motion in valve position control. Hunting behavior: over/under-correction cycle at set-point pressure.
work_description: Replaced APC butterfly valve seal kit P/N APC-VALVE-SEAL. Recalibrated APC valve position response and PID parameters. Verified pressure transducer calibration — within spec. Ran pressure step-response test at 800, 1000, 1200, and 1400 mTorr.
resolution: CLOSED — Chamber pressure stable within +/-2 mTorr at all set-points. Valve hunting eliminated. APC seal replacement interval set at 12 months.
